name: io.github.cyanheads/fdic-banks-mcp-server
description: Search FDIC-insured banks, Call Report financials, peer rankings, failures, deposit market share.

environmentVariables.name: FDIC_RATE_LIMIT_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum request starts per second to api.fdic.gov (1–15), shared by every caller of this process.

environmentVariables.name: FDIC_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: TTL of the in-process FDIC response cache in seconds; 0 disables caching.

environmentVariables.name: FDIC_PANEL_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Row cap for one fdic_query_financials panel (1,000–200,000). Newest quarters are kept when it binds.

environmentVariables.name: FDIC_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Per-table TTL for staged dataframes, in seconds (minimum 60).

environmentVariables.name: FDIC_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose fdic_dataframe_drop; otherwise it is registered disabled.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
